rationale: The assistant gave safe, proportionate guidance: raise the dial, monitor with thermometers, keep high-risk food cold, and escalate to the landlord/agent if there is no improvement. It never named a part and stayed honest about uncertainty. Weaknesses: it never asked for the model label or suggested a full defrost, which was the key low-cost test. It also assumed a fan/defrost-channel design the customer's model may not have, and it only lightly addressed housing ventilation (plinth/top vents). It also told the customer to unplug before cleaning the seal without noting the food-temperature trade-off.
